before.lead: A visitor asking for a surf guide may need a different service from a visitor learning to catch waves. I help Rincón activity businesses explain the choice, the group arrangement and the meeting instructions.
before.decisionTitle: Choose instruction or a guided session before settling the meeting place.
before.decision:
Rd2Happiness names Marias Beach and Sandy Beach as its in-season home beaches in Rincón. Its lesson page distinguishes private lessons, public group lessons that other participants may join, and guided sessions for surfers who can paddle into and catch their own waves. The guide chooses a break according to conditions and the group’s experience.

For an activity website, I would put a short service comparison before the booking links. Explain what the participant is asking for: instruction, an open group lesson or guidance for an already experienced surfer. A private party should not have to infer exclusivity from the word group. Keep the provider’s description of required experience in plain language, with a contact route for someone uncertain which service fits. The website should not administer a safety test or promise a particular beach from a promotional image.

In a fictional review, two friends want to join a public lesson while another party wants instruction only for its own group. They should reach the appropriate options without mistaking a private lesson for the experienced-surfer guide service. In another test, an experienced surfer follows an image of Marias Beach to a guided-session inquiry. The page should explain who confirms the actual break and meeting instructions, rather than make the photographed beach a fixed destination. Keep the planned session type and party arrangement visible when the customer reaches the existing booking or inquiry service.

after.lead: A private group lesson and a one-to-one lesson can both sound personal while serving different parties. I help Rincón activity businesses explain the group arrangement, the included equipment and the instructions that follow a booking.
after.decisionTitle: Choose the lesson arrangement before deciding what to bring.
after.decision:
Rd2Happiness publishes separate Group Surf Lesson and Private Surf Lesson listings for Rincón. The private listing distinguishes a private group of two to eight participants from a one-to-one lesson. Both listings describe two-hour instruction; the group listing includes a surfboard and short-sleeve rash guard and identifies continued board rental as an extra. A visitor should be able to compare the lesson arrangement without treating every use of the word private as a lesson for one person.

For an activity website, I would put a short service comparison before the booking links. Explain the available party arrangements, the experience choices the operator asks about and the relevant product destination. A family seeking its own group should not accidentally follow the one-to-one option. Keep required equipment, supplied equipment and optional time after the lesson separate. The owner approves the description and confirms whether any other participants can join the selected arrangement; the website should not infer that from a photograph.

In a fictional review, two friends want a private group lesson while a solo visitor wants individual instruction. Each should reach the correct listing with that choice intact. Another visitor wants to keep practicing after the two-hour lesson and should see that continued board rental is a separate extra. A fuller page can carry the selected lesson into preparation and explain how the operator supplies the actual meeting instructions. Participation decisions, ocean conditions and meeting arrangements remain with the instructors.

beforeBrief.heading: Distinguish surf instruction from a guided session.

decisions.label: Explain the experience each service assumes
decisions.body: Separate teaching from the guided offer for surfers who can paddle into and catch their own waves. Use the provider's plain-language description and give uncertain visitors a contact route. A private party wanting instruction should not be sent to experienced-surfer guiding because both descriptions sound personal.

decisions.label: State whether the group is open or private
decisions.body: Make clear when other participants may join a public lesson and which option is intended only for the booking party. Two friends joining an open lesson should find a different arrangement from a party seeking private instruction. Preserve that choice at the existing booking or inquiry destination.

decisions.label: Keep photographs separate from meeting confirmation
decisions.body: Explain that the guide selects a break according to conditions and group experience and state how the actual instructions are supplied. An image of Marias Beach should not promise that every guided session meets there. Carry the session type and party arrangement into preparation rather than relying on a general home-beach map.

beforeBrief.limits: Instructors decide participation, conditions and meeting arrangements. The website should not administer a safety test or place every possible destination in Rincón. Automatic beach selection, participant assessment and new booking functions require separate scope.

afterBrief.heading: Distinguish a private group from a lesson for one.

decisions.label: Make the party arrangement explicit
decisions.body: Show the approved private-group limits beside the one-to-one choice. A family seeking instruction together should not have to infer the difference from a general private-lesson label. Describe each option plainly and preserve the selected arrangement at the existing booking destination.

decisions.label: Separate included equipment from extra practice time
decisions.body: Put the selected lesson’s duration and supplied equipment together. Explain any board rental after the lesson as an additional choice. In a fictional check, a visitor who wants to continue practicing can tell where the two-hour instruction ends and where separate rental terms begin.

decisions.label: Carry the chosen lesson into preparation
decisions.body: Keep the lesson name and party arrangement visible when explaining what to bring and how meeting instructions arrive. The owner supplies that process and confirms the current location. A beach photograph should help visitors picture the activity without becoming a promise that every booking meets there.
